question: Who is noted as a pristine Indian Classical Dancer to perform at Salzburg Festival in 2015?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Alarmel Valli**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Alarmel Valli** is a renowned Bharatanatyam dancer from Chennai, India, who has been performing and teaching for over four decades.
 
• Established in 1920, the **Salzburg Festival **is a well-known music and theater festival.
 
• Every year, it takes place in Salzburg, Austria—the birthplace of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart—for five weeks beginning in late July.
 
• The annual production of Hofmannsthal's play Jedermann (Everyman) is a highlight of the festival, which focuses mostly on Mozart's operas.
 
• Additionally, since 1967, a different organization has organized an annual Salzburg Easter Festival.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Tanjore Balasaraswati was a celebrated Bharatanatyam dancer from the early 20th century who is known for her contributions to the art form.
 
• V. Satyanarayana Sarma is a Kuchipudi dancer and choreographer from Andhra Pradesh, India.
 
• Kumari Kamala was a prominent Bharatanatyam and Kathak dancer from India who rose to fame in the 1950s and 60s.
